No, nothing is guaranteed just by signing up, and it depends which $1,000 you mean. For the $1,000 stock offer, you only receive it if you meet the requirements, including that you must "Deposit at least $10,000 within 90 days of opening your account". For Instant advances, which are a separate product, "Not all Albert customers will qualify and few qualify for $1,000." I can't tell what you personally would qualify for, but support can help in the app.
